description: Calculate daily revenue by customer country for the online store. Revenue is the sum of total_amount for orders with status = 'completed'. The day is the UTC calendar date of order_ts. Output columns: order_day (DATE), country (STRING), total_revenue (FLOAT64), order_count (INT64). Sort by order_day, country.

country.description: ISO country code, may be NULL for legacy accounts

edge_cases: Order placed at 23:59:59 UTC belongs to that day; 00:00:00 belongs to the next day
Cancelled and pending orders must be excluded
Customers with NULL country should be reported under country = NULL, not dropped
common_failure_modes: FM2: Using DATE(order_ts, 'America/Los_Angeles') or a local timezone instead of UTC shifts orders across day boundaries
FM3: Grouping by order_ts instead of DATE(order_ts) produces one row per order
